# `satchel.yaml` Schema Reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_schema_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Product-agnostic source manifest for Satchel agent plugin packages.

- Schema ID: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkerhancock/satchel/main/schemas/satchel.schema.json`
- Required root fields: `schema`, `name`, `version`, `description`

## Root Fields

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema` | yes | `satchel/v0` | Satchel schema version. The current schema identifier is satchel/v0. Example: `"satchel/v0"`. |
| `name` | yes | `string` | Lowercase kebab-case package name copied into generated target manifests. Example: `"my-plugin"`. |
| `version` | yes | `string` | Package version copied into generated target manifests and archives. Example: `"0.1.0"`. |
| `description` | yes | `string` | Short package description copied into generated target manifests. Example: `"Shared agent extension."`. |
| `author` | no | `string` or `object` | Author metadata copied to targets that support it. |
| `homepage` | no | `string` | Project homepage URL copied where supported. Example: `"https://example.com/my-plugin"`. |
| `repository` | no | `string` | Source repository URL copied where supported. Example: `"https://github.com/example/my-plugin"`. |
| `license` | no | `string` | Package license identifier copied where supported. Example: `"MIT"`. |
| `keywords` | no | `array` | Search keywords copied where supported. Example: `["agents", "skills"]`. |

## Components

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `skills` | no | `component` | Portable skill directory. Each child skill needs SKILL.md. |
| `mcp` | no | `component` | JSON MCP server configuration. |
| `hooks` | no | `component` | Hook configuration copied or referenced by targets that support hooks. |
| `agents` | no | `component` | Agent definition directory for targets that support agents. |
| `commands` | no | `component` | Command definition directory for targets that support commands. |
| `lsp` | no | `component` | LSP server configuration for targets that support LSP. |
| `rules` | no | `component` | Rule files copied into experimental Antigravity output. |
| `apps` | no | `component` | Codex app configuration. |

## Targets

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `codex` | no | `target` | Codex plugin manifest and marketplace output. |
| `claude` | no | `target` | Claude plugin manifest and marketplace output. |
| `copilot` | no | `target` | GitHub Copilot plugin manifest and marketplace output. |
| `antigravity` | no | `target` | Experimental Antigravity local package output. |
| `chatgpt` | no | `target` | ChatGPT Apps SDK app metadata, submission checklist, and MCP release-readiness output. |
| `anthropic` | no | `target` | Anthropic Connectors Directory connector metadata and manual submission checklist (distinct from the claude Claude Code plugin target). |
| `cowork` | no | `target` | Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork plugin manifest (agentSkills + a remote-MCP-only agentConnectors entry from targets.cowork.connector). There is no local/stdio transport; an mcp component server declared via command/args cannot back this target and is flagged, not silently dropped. |

## Target Fields

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | no | `boolean` | Set false to disable this target. Default: `true`. |
| `notApplicable` | no | `string` | Reason an intentionally disabled target does not apply to this package. Requires enabled: false. |
| `manifest` | no | `string` | Relative path for the generated target manifest. |
| `rootManifest` | no | `string` | Optional extra root manifest path used by the Copilot target. |
| `output` | no | `string` | Output directory for targets that generate local package layouts. |
| `experimental` | no | `boolean` | Marks an enabled experimental target as intentionally experimental. |
| `displayName` | no | `string` | Human-facing display name used by targets that support it. |
| `app` | no | `object` | ChatGPT app metadata, including the remote MCP URL and submission URLs. |
| `compatibility` | no | `object` | ChatGPT compatibility checks and expectations such as read-only hints and search/fetch support. |
| `submission` | no | `string` or `object` | ChatGPT submission checklist output path, or a mapping with a path field. |
| `interface` | no | `object` | Codex interface metadata copied into the Codex plugin manifest. |
| `marketplace` | no | `object` | Marketplace catalog output configuration. |

## Marketplace Fields

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | no | `string` | Relative path for the generated marketplace file. |
| `name` | no | `string` | Marketplace catalog name. |
| `patch` | no | `boolean` | Preserve host-owned marketplace metadata while updating generated plugin fields. Default: `false`. |
| `source` | no | `string` or `object` | Target-specific plugin source declaration used by marketplace install flows. |
| `category` | no | `string` | Marketplace category copied where supported. |
| `description` | no | `string` | Marketplace-level description copied where supported. |
| `installation` | no | `string` | Codex marketplace installation policy. |
| `authentication` | no | `string` | Codex marketplace authentication policy. |
